title: Detecting Is Not Choosing: What a World Model Needs to Keep a VLA Policy Safe
abstract: arXiv:2611.29553v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies complete most benchmark tasks but often violate safety constraints. Since they are stochastic, one remedy is to sample several candidate action chunks and execute one that a world model predicts is safe. We ask what such a model must do. In simulation, a lookahead safety filter with the simulator as an exact world model raises the safety rate of three VLA policies on LIBERO and of pi0.5 on LIBERO-Plus by 11.5 to 25.7 points. It also helps pi0.5 on three RoboCasa tasks. Learned critics trained on one policy's data detect dangerous states (pooled AUROC up to 0.864) but rank candidates at one state close to chance (within-decision AUROC 0.551-0.560), and the learned dynamics and video models we test do no better. translated_title: 检测并非选择：世界模型需要具备什么能力才能保障VLA策略的安全
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略能够完成大多数基准任务，但常常违反安全约束。由于这类策略具有随机性，一种补救方法是采样多个候选动作块，并执行其中被世界模型预测为安全的那一个。我们探究这样的世界模型必须具备什么能力。在仿真中，以模拟器作为精确世界模型的前瞻式安全过滤器，将三个VLA策略在LIBERO上以及pi0.5在LIBERO-Plus上的安全率提升了11.5至25.7个百分点，并在三个RoboCasa任务上对pi0.5也有帮助。在单一策略数据上训练的学习型评论器（critic）能够检测危险状态（汇总AUROC高达0.864），但在同一状态下对候选动作进行排序的能力却接近随机水平（决策内AUROC仅为0.551-0.560），我们测试的学习型动力学模型和视频模型也没有表现得更好。当模拟器的状态受到扰动时，动作选择能力远早于危险检测能力开始退化。在闭环实验中，中位数3.18毫米的位置误差就会消除LIBERO-Spatial上70%的安全收益，部分原因在于……
tldr: 论文的核心发现是“检测危险状态”与“选择安全动作”是两种截然不同的能力：现有学习型评论器、动力学模型和视频模型虽能较好地检测危险状态，却几乎无法在同一状态下从候选动作中选出安全动作，且选择能力对状态误差远比检测更敏感，因此真正能保障VLA策略安全的世界模型必须具备精确的状态预测能力。
en_tdlr: The paper shows that detecting dangerous states is not the same as choosing safe actions: learned critics, dynamics, and video models can detect hazards well (pooled AUROC up to 0.864) but rank candidate actions near chance, and selection degrades under state perturbations far earlier than detection—so a world model that keeps VLA policies safe must provide precise state prediction.
